drills.name: spark_down
drills.question: If the Spark lane fails in working hours, who notices, how fast, and what still works?
timeline: Kyuubi stops accepting sessions (the Spark lane is down).
The gateway marks the lane down and runs queries up to 1 GiB on DuckDB instead; larger ones get 503 with a retry hint.
ticket_slow (ticket) fires.
ticket_fast (ticket) fires.
Kyuubi is back; the lane is used again after its health check.
ticket_fast resolves.
ticket_slow resolves.

drills.name: catalog_latency
drills.question: Does a slow catalog make every query slow, and does the latency SLO see it?
timeline: Iceberg REST catalog responses slow down by 2.5 s per table load.
Catalog latency back to normal.

drills.name: query_storm
drills.question: Can one runaway automation make the platform slow for everyone else?
drills.injected: 40 queries/s from one service user 11:00-11:10 UTC.
timeline: An n8n workflow loops: 40 distinct queries a second.
Admission control holds it to its 2 concurrent queries; the rest wait up to 5 s and are refused with 429.
The workflow is stopped.

drills.name: late_upstream
drills.question: When an upstream batch is late, who is told, and what do consumers see meanwhile?
drills.injected: raw.trades for 2026-06-04 lands 180 minutes after its usual 04:30.
timeline: The other raw tables land on time.
APR_ProductLate (ticket) for trades to #brokerage-data: no data for 2026-06-04 after 06:00.
APR_ProductLate (page) for daily_trading to #brokerage-analytics: no data for 2026-06-04 after 07:00.
raw.trades for 2026-06-04 lands, 180 minutes late.
trades published for 2026-06-04; the alert resolves.
The daily_trading DAG's sensor releases; dbt builds the mart.
daily_trading published for 2026-06-04; the alert resolves.

drills.name: bad_batch
drills.question: If a source sends a corrupt batch, does anyone read it before it is caught?
drills.injected: raw.trades for 2026-06-04 with 50 negative amounts and 20 duplicated trade ids.
timeline: The batch is written to the audit branch audit-2026-06-04.
Contract checks fail: unique on trade_id: 20 duplicates; positive on amount_eur: 50 rows <= 0.
main is not moved; the run is quarantined and the owner (#brokerage-data) is told. Readers keep the previous day's data.
The source re-sends a clean batch; it passes the checks and is published.
